# dotcomAI

> A unified AI platform that makes 400+ AI models and 50+ service providers accessible through one modern interface. Built in Sri Lanka 🇱🇰 by Manuja Damsara as a pilot project by DotcomOne & UniPOS.

dotcomAI is a premium AI/technology platform offering free and paid AI services. It brings hundreds of AI models and dozens of providers together behind a single, modern interface so users and developers can build intelligent software, AI-powered products, and digital experiences for the next generation.

## Features

- 400+ AI models in one platform
- 50+ service providers connected
- Free and paid AI services
- Unified, modern chat & model interface
- AI-powered products and digital experiences

## Platform

- Web app: https://home.dotcomai.site
- Official site: https://dotcomai.site
- Contact: support@dotcomai.site

## Ownership

dotcomAI is a flagship platform created by DotcomOne, in partnership with UniPOS. Founder & developer: Manuja Damsara.
